channel.title: M365 Roadmap Tracker — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily Microsoft 365 roadmap updates — new features, status changes, and AI summaries

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Delete meeting generated content in recap
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Meeting organizers in Microsoft Teams can now delete generated content like recordings and transcripts from the recap page using a new delete button. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams will have improved keyboard navigation and default line numbers in code blocks, making it easier for users to collaborate on code. This change affects all Teams users working with code blocks. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: New and Improved People Hub on Web
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook Web will feature a new People Hub with a modern interface, improved search, and automatic linking of duplicate contacts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Miracast support for Teams Rooms on Windows devices
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams Rooms on Windows devices will support Miracast for wireless sharing, in addition to existing HDMI options. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Action Segments
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] The Microsoft 365 admin center now allows IT admins to target Organizational Messages using dynamic, pre-defined usage segments. This change enhances message targeting for admins. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Messages now supports Email messages
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Organizational Messages in the Microsoft 365 admin center now supports Email as a delivery channel, expanding communication options for admins. This affects how messages are delivered to users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Endpoint DLP is expanding to include protection for Copilot and PC devices, focusing on Recall snapshots and policy enforcement. This affects Purview admins managing data protection policies. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Role groups UI enhancements
item.description: [NEW] The Role groups page in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal now allows admins to look up permissions by roles and memberships. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] SharePoint: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams
item.description: [NEW] Users will be able access an AI generated audio summary of SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams (Viva Connections). (GA: June CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Granular classification error controls (Exchange online)
item.description: [NEW] Granular Protections for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket polic (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts for government clouds
item.description: [NEW] We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents from returning a response when prompts contain sensit (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
item.description: [NEW] When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [NEW] Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
item.description: [NEW] Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. Adjust magnification from 10 percent to 500 percent using the slider in the lower-right corner or controls on the ribbon. Keyboard shortcuts are also available, ma (GA: June CY2026) — Access

item.title: [NEW] Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
item.description: [NEW] We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs. (GA: July CY2026) — Access

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: [NEW] Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Planner

item.title: [NEW] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot can analyze content shared on-screen
item.description: [NEW] Vision in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps you make faster, more informed decisions by understanding context from what you share on your screen. Copilot can analyze visual inputs from shared desktop screens and provide detailed insights about the content. Talk to Copilot for answers grounded in work and (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Pay-as-you-go model for Other Generative AI apps indicators
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will transition to a pay-as-you-go model for indicators related to Other Generative AI apps, affecting billing for users of these apps. (GA: March CY2027) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Planner: Available in Outlook
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] Planner is now available in Outlook, allowing users to manage tasks and plans directly within their inbox. (GA: May CY2026) — Planner

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Viva Glint - Action Taking Analysis Report
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] A new report in Viva Glint will provide insights into platform activity, including metrics like report views and team conversations. This affects Viva Glint users and administrators. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: [DATE_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
item.description: [DATE_CHANGED] A new agents usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center, detailing usage of M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat agents by licensed and unlicensed users. This impacts IT admins managing agent usage. (GA: July CY2026) — Microsoft 365 admin center, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [UPDATED] Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
item.description: [UPDATED] You’ll notice media quality improvements including support for up to 16 participant videos (4×4 grid) available in May and simulcast streaming (June) when using Direct Guest Join. These updates make cross‑platform meetings more immersive and reliable when joining Teams meetings from Zoom, Google Mee (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop - Admin usage reports for Loop
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] View and monitor Loop usage in the tenant through existing M365 admin usage dashboards. Updated May 11, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for the inconvenience. (GA: June CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Shadow AI
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge introduces a new UI for users blocked from sending prompts to Generative AI apps, redirecting them to M365 Copilot instead. This change affects users interacting with DLP policies. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Edge, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Data officers can now embed hyperlinks in warning and blocking toast messages for the Edge browser in Microsoft Purview. This feature helps direct users to specific resources when data loss prevention rules are triggered. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook: Delimiter setting admin policy
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Outlook admins can now set a default tenant-wide policy for using commas to separate recipients in Mail Compose and Reply settings. This affects all Outlook users. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Purview will introduce a feature to test files against sensitive information classifiers, helping users identify sensitive content. This affects users managing data classification. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Teams: Audio recap language expansion
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Teams will support audio recap in eight additional languages, enhancing accessibility for global users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365: Modernized Access Denied Web Experience
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 will have a refreshed Access Denied web experience, allowing users to request access to files and sites with improved visuals and messaging. This update affects all users encountering access issues. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, OneDrive, SharePoint

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: v.148 - Password affiliation service
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Edge will introduce a password affiliation service to improve autofill suggestions based on related domains. This change affects users of Edge across desktop and mobile platforms. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge: Microsoft Edge can now send work related browsing history to Copilot for more relevant work results when searching on M365 Copilot search
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Edge can now send selected work-related browsing history to Copilot to enhance search results. This impacts users who use Copilot search. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Edge, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot voice support in Word & PowerPoint.
item.description: [STATUS_CHANGED] Microsoft 365 Copilot will support voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint, allowing users to brainstorm and create content verbally. This affects users of Word and PowerPoint. (GA: December CY2025) — PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Add Breakout Room Participants in Bulk Using CSV
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow bulk assignment of breakout room participants using a CSV file, streamlining the setup process for organizers. This feature is relevant for Teams meeting organizers. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
item.description: Endpoint DLP will classify Azure RMS protected Office documents on Windows devices, triggered by file usage or just-in-time classification. This impacts IT administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Update Health
item.description: Cloud Update will provide enhanced error reporting for Microsoft 365 Apps updates, offering clearer error messages for failed updates. This feature helps admins diagnose issues more efficiently. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft Edge: Copilot New Tab Page
item.description: The new Copilot New Tab Page in Microsoft Edge will allow users to search, chat, and access curated content more efficiently. This change impacts all Edge users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Edge

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will provide a unified view of conversations, allowing users to easily catch up on chats and threads, impacting mobile users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Copilot provides coaching feedback in chat as you draft, edit and format emails
item.description: Outlook will now feature Copilot providing coaching feedback on email drafts, allowing users to apply suggestions directly. This change impacts all Outlook users drafting emails. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
item.description: Outlook will enable users to draft, edit, and format emails conversationally with Copilot, enhancing email composition. This change affects Outlook users. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: SharePoint: New SharePoint Experience
item.description: SharePoint is introducing a new experience focused on knowledge discovery and content publishing, with an updated design. This affects all SharePoint users. (GA: May CY2026) — SharePoint

item.title: Outlook: Import emails from PST file to mailbox in new Outlook for Windows
item.description: Users can import emails from PST files into their mailbox in the new Outlook for Windows. This feature will assist users migrating from older Outlook versions. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Badging updates help find messages that count in the chat list
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now display badges on the app bar to indicate activity in chats and channels, making it easier to find unread messages. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage Event Broadcast, Meetings and custom events with moderated feed, annoynmous posting on web & mobile
item.description: Viva Engage will enhance event broadcasting with moderated feeds and anonymous posting options for attendees. This affects event organizers and participants in large-scale events. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Purview: New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a new Data Security Posture Management experience to enhance data security and AI integration. This affects organizations using Purview. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-stream IntelliFrame support for GCC-H and DoD in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: GCC-H and DoD customers can use multi-stream IntelliFrame in Teams Rooms on Windows for improved visibility in hybrid meetings. This change affects Teams Rooms users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi‑camera view support for GCC-H and DoD in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: GCC-H and DoD customers can now switch between multiple camera feeds in Teams Rooms on Windows for better engagement. This change affects Teams Rooms users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams will allow users to filter chat and channel lists to show only unread items, with an eye icon to access read items without leaving the view. This feature impacts all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Honor Windows Do not disturb setting
item.description: Microsoft Teams will now respect the Windows Do Not Disturb setting, pausing notifications when enabled. This affects all Teams users. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft 365 Copilot app will introduce a branded footer that displays the organization’s logo and an 'Approved by' label. This change affects administrators managing branding settings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 app, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting participants can request collaborative annotation sessions
item.description: In Microsoft Teams meetings, participants can request to start collaborative annotation sessions, which require approval from the presenter. Organizers can control who can start annotations through a new Meeting Options setting. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Account Selector in Outlook Copilot Side Pane
item.description: Outlook adds an account selector in the Copilot side pane for users with multiple accounts, simplifying account management. This change affects users with multiple Copilot-enabled accounts. (GA: May CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Annotations on Teams Single Window Sharing on macOS
item.description: Teams on macOS will allow presenters to share a single application window and enable participant annotations, enhancing privacy and engagement during presentations. This affects Teams users on macOS. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Consecutive interpretation in Interpreter
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce consecutive interpretation, allowing turn-based interpretation during meetings for better interaction across languages. This change affects all Teams users participating in multilingual meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Branded Meeting Reactions
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizations to upload custom branded meeting reactions for participants. This change affects meeting experiences by enhancing brand visibility during meetings. (GA: May CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Triage your inbox on-the-go with Copilot voice for Outlook mobile
item.description: The Outlook mobile app will feature a Copilot voice experience to help users manage their inbox by summarizing unread emails and allowing actions like flagging or archiving. This change affects users of the Outlook mobile app. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: One-time email passcodes for external presenters in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will implement one-time email passcodes for verifying external presenters, impacting event organizers and tenant administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – Introducing new personal data examination
item.description: Data Security Investigations will introduce a focus on identifying personal data, enhancing the ability to extract sensitive information. This impacts security and compliance teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM data risk assessments: item-level investigation & remediation
item.description: Microsoft Purview will allow item-level investigation and remediation of SharePoint data, helping users manage overshared items with new insights. This affects SharePoint users and compliance teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Phone Device user multi-line
item.description: Teams Phone will allow administrators to assign up to 10 phone numbers to a single user, enabling seamless calling from multiple numbers. This feature benefits users managing diverse roles or regions. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Private channels increased limits and transition to group compliance
item.description: Private channels in Teams will transition to using a shared mailbox, increasing member limits and applying compliance policies. This affects Teams administrators and users managing private channels. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Task chat and mentions in basic plans
item.description: Planner will introduce task chat and mentions in basic plans, enabling team members to collaborate directly on tasks. This change affects users who manage tasks within Planner. (GA: January CY2026) — Planner

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot uses enterprise assets hosted on Adobe Experience Manager when creating presentations
item.description: M365 Copilot can create presentations using images from an organization's asset library hosted on Adobe Experience Manager. This change impacts users who connect their asset library to Copilot. (GA: April CY2026) — PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Backup RTMP Support for Teams town halls
item.description: Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to maintain live broadcasts during interruptions. This change affects users hosting town hall events in Teams. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Entra: Cross-tenant security group synchronization
item.description: Microsoft Entra introduces cross-tenant security group synchronization, allowing organizations to manage security groups across tenants. This affects IT admins managing multiple tenants. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Entra

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – AI analysis enhancements
item.description: Data Security Investigations in Microsoft Purview enhances AI analysis tools for faster categorization and data preparation. This change affects security teams conducting investigations. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Content Explorer – Enhanced Tag (SIT, Labels) Filter at UI Layer
item.description: Microsoft Purview's Content Explorer now has enhanced filtering controls for SIT and label data. This improves content discoverability and governance for admins. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: User reported security signals in Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft Teams now includes user-reported security signals in the admin center. Admins can view and analyze these reports to improve security policies. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Streamlined Microsoft 365 Certified App Management in Teams Admin Center
item.description: Microsoft Teams will streamline the management of Microsoft 365 certified apps through the Teams Admin Center, allowing admins to enable verified third-party applications. This change affects Microsoft 365 administrators. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhancements to Interpreter quality and support for Traditional Chinese
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve interpreter quality and now support Traditional Chinese, enhancing real-time interpretation accuracy and consistency for meetings. This change benefits users who require interpretation services. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Add support for Recommended Labels in Outlook mobile
item.description: Outlook mobile will support recommended sensitivity labels when composing emails, applying them automatically if policies are enabled. This feature helps users manage sensitive information more effectively. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Add support for Recommended Labels in Outlook mobile
item.description: Outlook mobile will support recommended sensitivity labels when composing emails, applying them automatically if policies are enabled. This feature helps users manage sensitive information more effectively. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Create workflows with slash commands
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to create workflows using slash commands directly in the compose box. This change affects Teams users creating workflows. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft 365 app: Microsoft Loop - Departed user content workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces
item.description: The Microsoft 365 app will manage retention and deletion workflows for user-owned Loop workspaces when users leave, affecting workspace management. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft 365 app

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher Output Formats
item.description: The Researcher Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot will offer new output formats for reports, allowing users to export to PowerPoint, PDF, Infographic, or Audio Overview. This affects users utilizing the Researcher Agent. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Resizable Gallery in Teams Meetings
item.description: Teams meetings now allow resizing of the top video gallery, enabling users to see more participants during content sharing. This change affects all Teams meeting participants. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Account Switching for Native Mac Controls via Dock and Menu Bar
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce account switching controls for Mac users, simplifying navigation between accounts and tenants. This change affects Teams users on Mac. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces export functionality for DLP and label policy configurations, allowing users to download settings as a ZIP file. This feature aids IT admins in troubleshooting. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Live transcription in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will support live transcription during meetings, including speaker names and timestamps. This feature is available for Teams Rooms Pro users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android can now display digital signage when not in use, with configuration options available for IT admins. This affects Teams Rooms users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Android console
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will enable ad-hoc room reservations directly from the console, helping users book rooms quickly. This feature is for Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot processing content with sensitivity labels supports all storage locations
item.description: Microsoft Purview's Data Loss Prevention policy will now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, regardless of where the files are stored. This change affects all users utilizing Copilot with sensitive content. (GA: April CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft 365, PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Real-time voice interactions in a podcast in Word
item.description: In Word, users can now interact in real time with podcasts created by Copilot, allowing voice questions while listening. This enhances the audio experience for users. (GA: April CY2026) — Word, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Admin setting for simpler meeting passcodes (numeric‑only)
item.description: Admins can enable a setting in Teams to generate numeric-only passcodes for meetings, with a warning about potential security risks. This impacts tenant admins and meeting organizers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Attendee capacity packs for Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will offer attendee capacity packs, enabling event organizers to increase attendance limits for Teams events. This change impacts event organizers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Video recap in Teams
item.description: Teams will now include video recaps of meetings, providing narrated highlights and key moments from recorded sessions. This feature affects all Teams users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
item.description: Outlook's Copilot Chat will be accessible in shared and delegate mailboxes for users with appropriate permissions. This affects users managing shared mailboxes. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
item.description: Users can now print calendar events from the new Outlook and Teams, with options to show or hide attendee lists. This change affects all calendar users. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Spoken language detection is now automatic
item.description: Microsoft Teams will automatically detect spoken languages during meetings, removing the need for manual selection. This change affects all Teams users utilizing live captions and transcripts. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention- Additional Diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection
item.description: Microsoft Purview will provide additional diagnostics for Data Loss Prevention, helping users identify sensitive information and applied policies in documents. This impacts users managing sensitive data. (GA: February CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Outlook: Draft emails using saved email snippets with Quick Parts for Outlook for Windows and web
item.description: Outlook for Windows and web now supports Quick Parts, allowing users to save and reuse email snippets for faster message drafting. This feature benefits all Outlook users. (GA: February CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: Insert Graphic
item.description: A new Graphics button in Outlook for Windows and web will allow users to insert emojis, stock photos, and stickers into messages. This change affects all users composing messages. (GA: April CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Notes now available for instant meetings
item.description: Teams meeting Notes, powered by Loop, are now available for instant meetings, allowing collaborative note-taking. This feature affects all users participating in Teams meetings. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Context preservation in Teams
item.description: Teams will automatically restore your workspace layout and selected messages when returning to a conversation shortly after leaving. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Planner: Planner Agent in group-based basic plans
item.description: The Planner Agent will be available for M365 Copilot licensed users in all group-based Planner plans, including basic plans. This impacts users utilizing Planner for task management. (GA: March CY2026) — Planner, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Consult and merge a PSTN caller through DTMF
item.description: Teams meeting organizers can now consult and merge PSTN callers during meetings, even when they require DTMF navigation. This feature affects users who organize meetings with PSTN callers. (GA: April CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Apply sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions in Office for the web in Microsoft 365
item.description: Office for the web will support applying sensitivity labels with user-defined permissions, enhancing data protection. This change affects users managing sensitive information. (GA: April CY2026) — Excel, Microsoft Purview, PowerPoint, Word

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard prompts
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention will expand to safeguard prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot that contain sensitive data. This impacts organizations using Copilot. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot
item.description: The Employee Self-Service Agent in M365 Copilot will assist employees with common HR and IT questions and tasks. This affects employees using Copilot for self-service. (GA: November CY2025) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified Teams app bar to create a cleaner and more focused experience.
item.description: Microsoft Teams is simplifying its app bar for a cleaner experience, making it easier to navigate apps. This change affects all Teams users. (GA: March CY2026) — Microsoft Teams
